description: The agent team for hierarchical tasks (dispatch --hierarchy, or "hierarchy": true on a backlog item). Level 1: the orchestrator plans and delegates (read-only). Level 2: each lead plans its own slice and starts workers. Level 3: workers do the work (created by leads at run time, with the lead's role). Rules enforced by the controller: lead scopes can only narrow their role's writable paths and never overlap, budgets only shrink downwards, a lead may only hand out files inside its scope, and every plan is validated before any worker starts.
